description: This file defines the DisplayHandler class and related structures for managing WebRTC display streaming, including frame processing, client management, and threading mechanisms within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: WebRtcScProcessedFrame
classes.description: Represents a processed WebRTC frame containing a video buffer, supporting move semantics and cloning.

classes.name: DisplayHandler
classes.description: Manages WebRTC display streaming, including frame handling, client management, and threading.

methods.name: DisplayHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display handler with necessary components.

methods.name: Loop
methods.description: Main loop for the display handler, runs indefinitely.

methods.name: SendLastFrame
methods.description: Sends the last frame to all or specific displays.

methods.name: GetScreenConnectorCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback for processing frames from the screen connector.

methods.name: RepeatFramesPeriodically
methods.description: Repeats frame sending at regular intervals.
